overall_strategy_summary: Goldman Sachs is executing a strategy focused on Global Banking & Markets and Asset & Wealth Management, having retreated from consumer banking (Marcus). Key digital: GS DAP tokenization platform (planned mid-2026 spinout), BNY MMF tokenization, Canton Network, active crypto trading desk. Technology: Banker Copilot, Research Assistant, Developer Copilot for 12K engineers (15% bug reduction), hundreds of autonomous AI coding agents planned. $1.8T wealth assets. Mathew McDermott leads digital assets. Strategic investments in Digital Asset, Tradeweb partnership.

business_segments.name: Asset & Wealth Management
business_segments.description: $1.8T wealth client assets. $355B alternative investments AUS. $18B quarterly fundraising. Management fees +9%. Private banking and lending.

technology_strategy.ai_and_genai: Banker Copilot for investment bankers. Research Assistant for analysts. Developer Copilot for 12,000 engineers (15% bug reduction). Plans for hundreds of autonomous AI coding agents (3-4x productivity boost). GS Financial Cloud platform.

technology_strategy.data_and_analytics: Marquee platform for client analytics and trading. Data-driven investment research. Risk analytics across all asset classes.

operating_model.transformation: Retreated from consumer banking (Marcus scaling back). Focused on core strengths: banking, markets, alternatives. GS DAP spinout to enable broader industry adoption. Efficiency through AI copilots.
operating_model.outsourcing_signals: Primarily builds internally. Strong engineering culture (12K engineers). GS DAP spinout signals willingness to externalise non-core platform.
operating_model.vendor_ecosystem: Digital Asset (DAML/Canton), Tradeweb (strategic partner), BNY (MMF distribution), Apple (Card partnership winding down).
operating_model.key_metrics: Q3 2025: $15.18B revenue, $4.1B net income, 20.2% ROE. $1.8T wealth client assets. $355B alternative AUS. 12K engineers.
